title: Ridge Vase
author: dynamico
description:
A simple vase with vertical grooves that looks modern and stylish.

Perfect as a decoration or for small flower arrangements.

Tip: Don't scale the model too small, as it might not stand out as much, like it happened to me. I had to scale it down because of time constraints, but I still think it looks pretty cool, even though it might appear a bit incomplete.

Powered by MakerWorld-Make My Vase (https://makerworld.com/makerlab/makeMyVase)
